nodes.question: What is the significance of IoT sensors integration in an automated denim factory for sustainability and technology?
nodes.answer: IoT sensors integration in an automated denim factory is significant for sustainability and technology as it allows for real-time monitoring of processes, resource utilization, and environmental performance, thereby promoting sustainable practices and technological advancements in the fashion industry.
